summary: Ocean Capital Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K announcing that holders of its units may elect to separately trade the underlying ordinary shares, rights, and warrants starting August 3, 2026. The units consist of one ordinary share, one right, and one warrant, and will continue trading as OCACU on the NYSE, while separated components will trade under OCAC, OCACR, and OCACW. This is a routine administrative announcement regarding unit separation, not a special situation event. Holders must contact the transfer agent to separate units. No financial terms, board recommendations, or strategic implications are provided.
